line: Help has one search box and three tabs, shows each login only what it can use, and the tour starts when you choose.
Handover sign-offs now belong to each ward, and a site bed manager can sign off its own site's handover.
Roles read Nurse in charge, Community team and Site bed manager; hidden names say "Name not shown on this desk".
The ED page is now a handover table with Presentation and Form choices, and one Lists card.
Alerts is redesigned, with a Today band, a side panel with one action bar, and Add units on a live broadcast.
Community teams can find a client or clinician; ED, Movements and Go to a desk read more cleanly on phone.
Community: a clinic with several names, like Armadale's Mead Centre, lists all its patients under each name.
Downtime pack: on a tablet or computer, each tab shows just its own table. Printing still includes all four.
Same words everywhere (Locked, movements, held up, Bed board), and long names and iPads behave better.
Help: Show me around walks you through each screen. Each answer can be rated helpful and has Copy link.
Tools is redesigned: recent tools first, Remind me, Due back, ready-made messages and an order for each desk.
Unconfirmed saves retry safely, closed beds stop planned arrivals, and a missing legal form shows No form recorded.
Remind me reminders now show in Alerts when they are due. Tap Done to clear one.
Pages scroll as one, with headings pinned under the top bar, and a click outside a drawer now closes it.
Home now shows Needs you and Flow, with tabs for each stage, from needing a bed to moving.
ED journey totals, community origins and downtime departure lists now use consistent meanings.
Tools has Quick actions for the bed coordinator, with Ward updates listing wards not confirmed this shift.
Neater drop-down lists, graph dots that stay put when pressed, and page tips once per device with Turn off tips.
Waiting shows Today's follow-up and a clearer daily check. All EDs filters hide other EDs, with a By ED view.
Settings has one Alerts on this device switch, and Test alert shows a sample alert here in Ward Flow.
